landing.heroTagline: 人性盛开之处，自然重生。
landing.description: 一个文学传奇和跨媒体生态系统，通过创新形式将195种国花及其传粉者联系在一起：插图书籍、引人入胜的卡牌游戏、全面的3D花卉档案和互动机器人展览。
landing.bookDesc: 一段穿越世界最美丽花卉的插图文学之旅
landing.gameDesc: 庆祝全球花卉多样性的互动游戏
landing.exhibitionDesc: 让花卉栩栩如生的博物馆体验
landing.visionText: 通过花卉的通用语言连接文化，提高对生物多样性的认识，并在全球范围内促进机构和编辑合作。
landing.storyText: 《Nahiara与花之守护者》不仅仅是一本书——它是通向一个神奇世界的大门，在那里每一朵国花都讲述着一个故事。通过这种互动数字体验，您可以探索启发这个故事的195朵花，并发现文化、自然和保护之间的现实世界联系。
landing.journeyText: 这本书只是开始。探索Nahiara世界的完整数字生态系统。
landing.archiveDesc2: 以惊人的3D细节探索所有195种国花。点击任何花朵，了解其文化意义、保护状态以及在Nahiara故事中的角色。
landing.sagaDesc: 发现完整的文学宇宙，包括插图卡牌游戏、机器人展览和教育资源，将Nahiara的世界栩栩如生。
landing.communityText: 您现在是一个由读者、教育者和保护主义者组成的不断壮大的社区的一部分，他们相信讲故事的力量可以连接文化和保护生物多样性。分享您的经验，与其他花卉守护者联系，帮助我们将Nahiara的信息传播到世界各地。
landing.shareText: 帮助我们传播Nahiara的信息！分享您对这本书的想法，在您的帖子中标记我们，并与世界各地的其他读者联系。

alliances.title: 学术与机构合作
alliances.body1: 国际花卉保护协会已与 Lovely Professional University（印度旁遮普）达成合作协议，并欢迎 Aditya Singh 于 2026 年 5 月至 6 月期间加入实习。
alliances.body2: 这一合作进一步强化了我们对国际教育协作以及具有全球视野机构之间知识交流的承诺。
alliances.body3: 我们衷心感谢 LPU 的支持，以及其对本协会工作的机构层面认可。
alliances.futureBody: 该页面将随着项目的国际扩展持续新增更多学术与机构合作伙伴。

overview.title: A publication that tracks living floral heritage country by country.
overview.description: This archive works as an editorial desk. Dossiers are published only after botanical verification, source review, and rights checks.

series.title: Flowers That Changed the World
series.description: Blocks I to V present a verified bilingual documentary path from symbolic origins to current conservation urgency.
series.contextLine: Blocks I - V · Bilingual edition ES / EN
series.footnote: Documentary research by the International Association in Defence of Flowers.

I.title: The symbolic origin
I.summary: Flowers represented nations long before modern states were formed.

II.title: The silence also speaks
II.summary: Countries without an official flower reveal historical and political fractures.

III.title: The paper archive
III.summary: Philately built the broadest visual archive of floral identity.

IV.title: When the symbol faces extinction
IV.altTitle: Cuando el simbolo se enfrenta a la extincion
IV.summary: The biodiversity crisis threatens national flowers and pollinators.

V.title: The garden we can still save
V.altTitle: El jardin que aun podemos salvar
V.summary: Governments, science, and citizens define the living future of this symbol.

one.title: Find by country, flower, or SAN code
one.description: The launch explorer accepts historical names, scientific names, and coded identifiers from the same field.

two.title: Every launch country has a visual profile
two.description: The initial eight dossiers include flower imagery, conservation signal, and editorial metadata for direct review.

three.title: Built to scale to all 195 countries
three.description: The same card system used for launch countries is aligned with the full publication queue and weekly release cycle.

explorer.title: Launch countries with searchable floral dossiers
explorer.description: Browse the first eight countries through a cleaner mobile-first explorer with text search, continent filter, and conservation filter.
explorer.searchLabel: Search country, flower, scientific name, or SAN

navigator.title: 195 countries, grouped for browsing
navigator.description: The full ledger is structured from day one. Published profiles are live links, while pending countries remain visible as part of the publication queue.

protocol.title: Verified release cycle
protocol.description: Every dossier follows a fixed editorial sequence before publication. The queue below shows countries currently staged for upcoming cycles.

one.title: Source capture
one.description: National designation sources, stamp records, and botanical notes are gathered into one working sheet.

two.title: Scientific review
two.description: Scientific naming and taxonomic consistency are verified before a profile can move to production.

three.title: Rights check
three.description: Image and stamp assets are released only when licensing and source rights are clear.

four.title: Multilingual edit
four.description: ES, EN, and DE copy is edited and aligned so each dossier ships as one coherent publication.

archivePage.footerNote: The Flower Archive is maintained as a long-horizon publication of the International Association for the Defense of Flowers.
